convention.empirical_mse: mean_r (Q_r - Q_ref)^2 = bias^2 + s^2 (n-1)/n, s^2 with ddof=1
convention.interval_reading: an interval containing 1 means UNRESOLVED at this sample size, not that the effect is absent

field.source: reproduction/evidence/principal_fields.npz (independent replay of output/principal_burgers_runs at N=8192, h=0.005, nu=0.1, T=1, 48 pairs)

nonlinear.source: same archive as the field comparison, with observable definitions in the driver docstring

cost.scope: serial single-machine wall-clock, interleaved repetitions, solver only; an implementation result, not an intrinsic property of within-sign pairing

mechanism.note: variance ratios use advance_pair_flux, which implements WITHIN correctly; the sep_ratio column of this archive is defective and is superseded by output/matched_pair_separation/separation.json

separation.geometric_fact: for two equally sized sets of reals, matching in sorted order minimises the total absolute matched distance over all bijections; within-sign matching is a constrained bijection, so every entry of the matched-state table is <= 1 by construction

heldout_A.target_provenance: PILOT-INFORMED after round-16; the original 5e-6 experiment was never run (budget gate)

rqmc.scramble: LMS + digital random shift (per SciPy docs); NOT fully nested Owen scrambling
rqmc.sequence_use: one engine per replicate; successive time steps consume successive blocks of N=2^m points

rows.new_here: FULL/WITHIN formed here from the archived integrated variances
FULL/WITHIN formed here from the archived integrated variances

controls.source: output/controls_and_costs/{fields.npz,rows.csv} (N=1600, h=0.005, nu=0.1, T=1, 64 seeds, arms share seed streams)
controls.paired_bootstrap: same resampled replicate indices in both arms

bias_regime.caveat: three cells indicate a direction; they do not establish an asymptotic rate or separate all N/h interactions

final_stage_check.statement: V_reflect - V_switch = (1/4) sum_{unlike} |m_A m_B| [g_{2 sigma}(d) - |d|], conditional on the pre-final paired state, whole-line integrated variance of the pair mean
final_stage_check.note: the Monte Carlo estimate uses a bounded window containing every realised particle plus 8 sigma; the identity is whole-line. Refining the window grid from 6001 to 16001 points moved the estimate by 0.02% at the checked state, so the residual gap at 4000 draws was Monte Carlo error, not quadrature error. Historical key guaranteed_share means an estimated final-only/full-history reduction ratio; it is not a guaranteed share of terminal improvement.

calibration.superseded: output/principal_burgers_runs/calibration.json used one standardised shape for both synthetic arms
calibration.construction: standardise the RAW and FULL per-replicate samples separately; resample the FULL shape (scaled) against the RAW shape to impose a known variance ratio; count coverage. The common-shape design of round 22 is rerun as a control.
calibration.limitation: performance under these empirical distributions and this configuration; not a guarantee for other problems

counterexample.scope: two particles, strongly transport-dominated (R ~ 2.5e3). It does NOT show FULL worse than RAW, does not invalidate the measured gains at nu=0.1 with large N (R ~ 1e-4), and does not exclude a theorem carrying explicit resolution assumptions.

diagnostic.status: subordinate; the exponent is not stable under the tail cut and is not reported as a scaling law
